```{r}
res_hiv_fu_baseline_panel <- res_hiv_fu_baseline |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 0.25) %>%
  mutate(Class = "HIV") |>
  mutate(Scaled_Importance = scales::rescale(abs(logFC), to = c(0, 1))) %>%
  mutate(Importance = logFC) |>
  mutate(Sign = sign(Importance)) |>
  mutate(Sign= ifelse(Sign == 1, "POS", "NEG")) |>
  select(Feature, Importance, Sign, Scaled_Importance, Class)

cvd_hdba_res_panel <- cvd_hdba_res |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 0.25) %>%
  mutate(Class = "CVD") |>
  mutate(Scaled_Importance = scales::rescale(abs(logFC), to = c(0, 1))) %>%
  mutate(Importance = logFC) |>
  mutate(Sign = sign(Importance)) |>
  mutate(Sign= ifelse(Sign == 1, "POS", "NEG")) |>
  select(Feature, Importance, Sign, Scaled_Importance, Class)

met_hdba_res_panel <- met_hdba_res |>
  filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05 & abs(logFC) > 0.25) %>%
  mutate(Class = "Met") |>
  mutate(Scaled_Importance = scales::rescale(abs(logFC), to = c(0, 1))) %>%
  mutate(Importance = logFC) |>
  mutate(Sign = sign(Importance)) |>
  mutate(Sign= ifelse(Sign == 1, "POS", "NEG")) |>
  select(Feature, Importance, Sign, Scaled_Importance, Class)

feature_panel <- res_hiv_fu_baseline_panel |>
  bind_rows(cvd_hdba_res_panel) |>
  bind_rows(met_hdba_res_panel)

overlap_plot <- hd_plot_feature_network(feature_panel,
                        plot_color = "Scaled_Importance",
                        seed = 123,
                        importance_palette = c("high" = "firebrick", "low" = "white"))


overlap_plot

ggsave(
  filename = "HIV FU baseline CVD HDBA Met HDBA.pdf",
  path     = "../plots/pdf/overlap/",
  width    = 20,
  height   = 24)

ggsave(
  filename = "HIV FU baseline CVD HDBA Met HDBA.png",
  path     = "../plots/png/overlap/",
  width    = 20,
  height   = 24)
```

# Upset

```{r}
up_sets <- list(
  HIV_FU_vs_BL = res_hiv_fu_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC > 0.25) |>
    pull(Feature),

  Cardiovascular_vs_HDBA = cvd_hdba_res |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC > 0.25) |>
    pull(Feature),

  Metabolic_vs_HDBA = met_hdba_res |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC > 0.25) |>
    pull(Feature)
)

up_mat <- UpSetR::fromList(up_sets)

pdf("../plots/pdf/overlap/upset_upregulated_proteins.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

UpSetR::upset(
  up_mat,
  order.by = "freq",
  mainbar.y.label = "Upregulated proteins",
  sets.x.label = "Proteins per comparison"
)

dev.off()
```


# igraph

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(igraph)
```

```{r}
up_df <- tibble(
  Feature = unique(c(
    up_sets$HIV_FU_vs_BL,
    up_sets$Cardiovascular_vs_HDBA,
    up_sets$Metabolic_vs_HDBA
  )),
  HIV = Feature %in% up_sets$HIV_FU_vs_BL,
  CVD = Feature %in% up_sets$Cardiovascular_vs_HDBA,
  Met = Feature %in% up_sets$Metabolic_vs_HDBA
)

up_df_filtered <- up_df |>
  filter(!(HIV & !CVD & !Met))

up_edges <- up_df_filtered |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(HIV, CVD, Met),
    names_to = "Disease",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  filter(present) |>
  mutate(
    Disease = recode(
      Disease,
      HIV = "HIV_FU",
      CVD = "Cardiovascular",
      Met = "Metabolic"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Disease, Feature)

g_up <- graph_from_data_frame(
  up_edges,
  directed = FALSE
)

V(g_up)$type <- ifelse(
  V(g_up)$name %in% up_edges$Disease,
  "Disease",
  "Protein"
)

V(g_up)$color <- ifelse(
  V(g_up)$type == "Disease",
  "grey40",
  "firebrick"
)

V(g_up)$size <- ifelse(
  V(g_up)$type == "Disease",
  20,
  5
)

set.seed(123)

plot(
  g_up,
  layout = layout_with_fr(g_up),
  vertex.label.cex = ifelse(V(g_up)$type == "Disease", 1.2, 0.6),
  vertex.label.color = "black",
  edge.color = "grey80",
  main = "Upregulated proteins shared with cardiovascular and/or metabolic disease"
)
```

# New attempt

```{r}
fdr_cutoff  <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.25

up_sets <- list(
  HIV = res_hiv_fu_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature),

  CVD = cvd_hdba_res |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature),

  Met = met_hdba_res |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC > logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature)
)

down_sets <- list(
  HIV = res_hiv_fu_baseline |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC < -logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature),

  CVD = cvd_hdba_res |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC < -logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature),

  Met = met_hdba_res |>
    filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC < -logfc_cutoff) |>
    pull(Feature)
)

up_df <- tibble(
  Feature = unique(unlist(up_sets)),
  HIV = Feature %in% up_sets$HIV,
  CVD = Feature %in% up_sets$CVD,
  Met = Feature %in% up_sets$Met,
  Direction = "Up"
) |>
  filter(!(HIV & !CVD & !Met))   # ❌ remove HIV-only

down_df <- tibble(
  Feature = unique(unlist(down_sets)),
  HIV = Feature %in% down_sets$HIV,
  CVD = Feature %in% down_sets$CVD,
  Met = Feature %in% down_sets$Met,
  Direction = "Down"
) |>
  filter(!(HIV & !CVD & !Met))   # ❌ remove HIV-only

combined_df <- bind_rows(up_df, down_df)

edges <- combined_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(HIV, CVD, Met),
    names_to = "Disease",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  filter(present) |>
  mutate(
    Disease = recode(
      Disease,
      HIV = "HIV_FU",
      CVD = "Cardiovascular",
      Met = "Metabolic"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Disease, Feature, Direction)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges,
  directed = FALSE
)

# Node type
V(g)$type <- ifelse(
  V(g)$name %in% edges$Disease,
  "Disease",
  "Protein"
)

# Direction (proteins only)
protein_direction <- combined_df |>
  select(Feature, Direction)

V(g)$Direction <- ifelse(
  V(g)$type == "Protein",
  protein_direction$Direction[
    match(V(g)$name, protein_direction$Feature)
  ],
  NA
)

# Node colors
V(g)$color <- case_when(
  V(g)$type == "Disease"        ~ "grey40",
  V(g)$Direction == "Up"        ~ "firebrick",
  V(g)$Direction == "Down"      ~ "steelblue",
  TRUE                          ~ "grey80"
)

# Node sizes
V(g)$size <- ifelse(
  V(g)$type == "Disease",
  22,
  5
)

set.seed(123)

pdf("../plots/pdf/overlap/shared_proteomic_programs_network.pdf", width = 20, height = 20)

plot(
  g,
  layout = layout_with_fr(g),
  vertex.label.cex = ifelse(V(g)$type == "Disease", 1.2, 0.5),
  vertex.label.color = "black",
  edge.color = "grey80",
  main = "Shared proteomic programs across HIV follow-up, cardiovascular, and metabolic disease"
)

dev.off()
```


# Overlaps Treatment FU Baseline

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(igraph)

# -----------------------------
# Cutoffs
# -----------------------------
fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.5

# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
extract_sets <- function(res, direction) {
  if (direction == "Up") {
    res |> filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC >  logfc_cutoff) |> pull(Feature)
  } else {
    res |> filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, logFC < -logfc_cutoff) |> pull(Feature)
  }
}

# -----------------------------
# Define treatment-specific sets
# -----------------------------
up_sets <- list(
  INSTI_AA = extract_sets(res_instiaa_fu_baseline, "Up"),
  INSTI_TE = extract_sets(res_instite_fu_baseline, "Up"),
  NNRTI_TE = extract_sets(res_nnrtite_fu_baseline, "Up")
)

down_sets <- list(
  INSTI_AA = extract_sets(res_instiaa_fu_baseline, "Down"),
  INSTI_TE = extract_sets(res_instite_fu_baseline, "Down"),
  NNRTI_TE = extract_sets(res_nnrtite_fu_baseline, "Down")
)

# -----------------------------
# Build presence tables
# -----------------------------
build_presence <- function(sets, direction) {
  tibble(
    Feature = unique(unlist(sets)),
    INSTI_AA = Feature %in% sets$INSTI_AA,
    INSTI_TE = Feature %in% sets$INSTI_TE,
    NNRTI_TE = Feature %in% sets$NNRTI_TE,
    Direction = direction
  ) |>
    # 🔑 KEEP only proteins shared by ≥2 treatments
    mutate(n_assoc = INSTI_AA + INSTI_TE + NNRTI_TE) |>
    filter(n_assoc >= 2) |>
    select(-n_assoc)
}

up_df   <- build_presence(up_sets,   "Up")
down_df <- build_presence(down_sets, "Down")

combined_df <- bind_rows(up_df, down_df)

# -----------------------------
# Convert to edge list
# -----------------------------
edges <- combined_df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(INSTI_AA, INSTI_TE, NNRTI_TE),
    names_to = "Treatment",
    values_to = "present"
  ) |>
  filter(present) |>
  mutate(
    Treatment = recode(
      Treatment,
      INSTI_AA = "INSTI + Abacavir",
      INSTI_TE = "INSTI + Tenofovir",
      NNRTI_TE = "NNRTI + Tenofovir"
    )
  ) |>
  select(Treatment, Feature, Direction)

# -----------------------------
# Build graph
# -----------------------------
g <- graph_from_data_frame(
  d = edges,
  directed = FALSE
)

# -----------------------------
# Node attributes
# -----------------------------
V(g)$type <- ifelse(
  V(g)$name %in% edges$Treatment,
  "Treatment",
  "Protein"
)

# Direction (proteins only)
protein_direction <- combined_df |>
  select(Feature, Direction)

V(g)$Direction <- ifelse(
  V(g)$type == "Protein",
  protein_direction$Direction[
    match(V(g)$name, protein_direction$Feature)
  ],
  NA
)

# Colors
V(g)$color <- case_when(
  V(g)$type == "Treatment" ~ "grey40",
  V(g)$Direction == "Up"   ~ "firebrick",
  V(g)$Direction == "Down" ~ "steelblue",
  TRUE                     ~ "grey80"
)

# Sizes
V(g)$size <- ifelse(
  V(g)$type == "Treatment",
  22,
  5
)

# -----------------------------
# Plot
# -----------------------------
set.seed(123)

pdf(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/shared_proteomic_programs_network_by_treatment.pdf",
  width  = 20,
  height = 20
)

plot(
  g,
  layout = layout_with_fr(g),
  vertex.label.cex = ifelse(V(g)$type == "Treatment", 1.2, 0.5),
  vertex.label.color = "black",
  edge.color = "grey80",
  main = "Shared proteomic programs across ART regimens\n(Follow-up vs Baseline)"
)

dev.off()
```

```{r}
#install.packages("ggvenn")  # run once if needed
library(ggvenn)
library(dplyr)

fdr_cutoff   <- 0.05
logfc_cutoff <- 0.25

venn_sets <- list(
  "INSTI + Abacavir" =
    res_instiaa_fu_baseline |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  "INSTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_instite_fu_baseline |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature),

  "NNRTI + Tenofovir" =
    res_nnrtite_fu_baseline |>
      filter(adj.P.Val < fdr_cutoff, abs(logFC) > logfc_cutoff) |>
      pull(Feature)
)

plot_overlap_treatment <- ggvenn(
  venn_sets,
  show_elements = FALSE,      # 🔑 prints protein names
  set_name_size = 5,
  text_size     = 3
) +
  ggtitle("Overlap of differentially abundant proteins\n(Follow-up vs Baseline by ART regimen)")

plot_overlap_treatment

ggsave(
  "../plots/pdf/overlap/venn_treatment_overlap.pdf",
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)

ggsave(
  "../plots/png/overlap/venn_treatment_overlap.png",
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)

```
